external:puff-puff-push.title: Puff Puff Push by Typimals
external:puff-puff-push.description: Puff Puff Push! Welcome to Puff Puff Push Arena! Where 2 to 8 pufferfishes fight each other in king of the hill lightning quick matches ! Puff & Push your way to victory Your goal is to push your contestants off the arena. The last player standing wins! Once everyone is ready, the match will start! Puffer type Each puffer fish has it's own characteristic when puffing! Find the one that suits your style! Controls Controls are simple : move around with the joystick, hold down the Square(PlayStation)/ X(Xbox)/Y(Nintendo) button to inflate, then release to deflate!

external:supertuxkart.title: SuperTuxKart
external:supertuxkart.description: SuperTuxKart Evolution The next major release of SuperTuxKart, named SuperTuxKart Evolution is currently under development. Building upon the foundation laid by all those who made STK what it is today, SuperTuxKart Evolution will be the biggest release in STK’s history in terms of new content : new tracks, new features, improved gameplay, enhanced graphics, and much more. An overview of our roadmap is available here . As part of our efforts towards SuperTuxKart Evolution, the SuperTuxKart team will also improve communication with the community, with more frequent updates on our plans. A new forum has been opened for people to talk about the game and ask us questions. We also want to make it easier for new contributors to join us on our journey. Additional information is available in our STK Evolution FAQ . Discover more… Download Linux | Windows | macOS | Android Contents Latest Blog Posts ..:: Transforming Candela City into our best track ::.. ..:: The Electro-Shield, a new powerup for SuperTuxKart Evolution ::.. ..:: SuperTuxKart Evolution’s new logo ::.. ..:: The History of SuperTuxKart ::.. ..:: SuperTuxKart Evolution: Freytra Peaks making of ::.. ..:: My return to SuperTuxKart ::.. ..:: SuperTuxKart Evolution: Karting without a hitch ::.. ..:: SuperTuxKart 1.5 is now available on iOS ::.. ..:: SuperTuxKart 1.5 Gift Package trailer ::.. ..:: SuperTuxKart 1.5 release ::.. ..:: SuperTuxKart Evolution Roadmap ::.. ..:: 1.5-rc2 released, new Forum, and more ! ::.. ..:: Announcing SuperTuxKart Evolution ::.. ..:: Release Candidate for SuperTuxKart 1.5 ::.. ..:: SuperTuxkart 1.5-beta1 is available! ::.. ..:: Why average FPS and 1% low FPS are misleading ::.. ..:: On the way towards 1.5… and 2.0! ::.. Latest Blog Posts ..:: Transforming Candela City into our best track ::.. Candela City is receiving a total overhaul for SuperTuxKart Evolution. Gameplay, models, textures - everything has been overhauled to produce a fantastic track. You can watch our video to see the new Candela in motion, or read our blog post for plenty of extra details and pictures about the improvements we made and why we made them. Or even better, you can do both! We have spared no effort when making them, and if you like SuperTuxKart, we guarantee you’ll enjoy them. September 30, 2026 by Alayan ..:: The Electro-Shield, a new powerup for SuperTuxKart Evolution ::.. One of the great novelties that will come with SuperTuxKart Evolution is an expanded powerup set, to increase the fun of new and experienced players alike. In this blog post, we take a deep dive into the electro-shield , the first of the new powerups, looking at how we designed it and how it works. July 12, 2026 by Alayan ..:: SuperTuxKart Evolution’s new logo ::.. With a new game comes the need for a new logo. Thanks to a new contributor, we now have a beautiful one. Read the full blog post for more pictures and animations showcasing the new logo, as well as thoughts on the design process behind it. June 25, 2026 by Vollstock ..:: The History of SuperTuxKart ::.. To celebrate the 7th anniversary of SuperTuxKart 1.0’s release, the SuperTuxKart team is happy to present an entirely new history page that explores over two decades of development! From the times of TuxKart to SuperTuxKart Evolution, this history page, illustrated with many pictures, will let you discover your favorite game’s journey. The full blog post announcing this new page also gives an update on some recent changes to our website and upcoming plans so be sure to check it out! April 20, 2026 by Alayan ..:: SuperTuxKart Evolution: Freytra Peaks making of ::.. After years of racing through Snow Peak’s icy slopes, racers are getting a new track. In this blog post, we’ll look at the creation process behind the upcoming track “Freytra Peaks”, which will be included in the main game with the release of STK Evolution. Explore the creative process behind the track’s design and the techniques used to bring it to life, illustrated with images and a video in the full blog post . March 19, 2026 by Sven ..:: My return to SuperTuxKart ::.. In 2017, I left SuperTuxKart on the highest note imaginable - a standing ovation at the Blender Conference in Amsterdam as we launched the mobile version. I believed then, and still do, that it’s better to end with a firework than fade slowly into irrelevance. I thought that chapter was closed. But sometimes, a project you love calls you back - not because your story wasn’t complete, but because there’s a new story to write. Read my blog post to learn about my journey with STK. January 21, 2026 by Samuncle ..:: SuperTuxKart Evolution: Karting without a hitch ::.. This first blog post exploring the gameplay novelties and improvements we are working on for SuperTuxKart Evolution looks at collisions between karts, the collection of track items, jumps, and several other topics. Pictures, charts and even a video help illustrate the various gameplay changes that the text talks about, around a common theme of making the gameplay more consistent, intuitive and fun. Find out more in the full blog post . December 3, 2025 by Alayan ..:: SuperTuxKart 1.5 is now available on iOS ::.. Devee, a former member of the STK team who previously authored the Android port, has recently published the game on the Apple App Store. Learn more in our blog post . November 22, 2025 by Alayan ..:: SuperTuxKart 1.5 Gift Package trailer ::.. A new STK video showcasing Freytra Peaks and Drainage Dash, two of the new tracks designed for SuperTuxKart Evolution, has been released. These tracks are available in early access for donators as part of the 1.5 gift package . The gift package has also been updated to fix some very minor issues (missing sparks in Drainage Dash, some warning message in the logs) as well as add egg hunts to Freytra Peaks. November 8, 2025 by Alayan ..:: SuperTuxKart 1.5 release ::.. STK 1.5 is finally here! It brings a wide array of changes, including graphical improvements, new soccer fields and egg hunts, six new themes, a new benchmark mode, UI enhancements, and more. A gift package featuring 2 tracks designed for SuperTuxKart Evolution is also available for donators . Learn more by reading the full blog post here . Get the new version on our download page . October 20, 2025 by Alayan ..:: SuperTuxKart Evolution Roadmap ::.. An overview of the roadmap for SuperTuxKart Evolution is now available! Get all the details by reading the full blog post here . September 23, 2025 by the SuperTuxKart Team ..:: 1.5-rc2 released, new Forum, and more ! ::.. The second release candidate for SuperTuxKart 1.5 is now available for download , and a brand new forum has been opened. All the details about this, and some other exciting news, in our full blog post . September 7, 2025 by Alayan ..:: Announcing SuperTuxKart Evolution ::.. The SuperTuxKart project is entering a new phase of its development, with SuperTuxKart Evolution as the next step in its journey. Read the full blog post here . Additional information is available in our FAQ about STK Evolution . August 26, 2025 by Alayan ..:: Release Candidate for SuperTuxKart 1.5 ::.. The way to 1.5 was longer and windier than anticipated, but it’s finally around the corner. Binaries for Linux, Windows, Android and Mac are available here . Read the full blog post here . May 27, 2025 by Alayan ..:: SuperTuxkart 1.5-beta1 is available! ::.. Boo! The SuperTuxKart team is happy to announce the release of the first beta for STK 1.5. Binaries for Linux, Windows, Android and Mac are available here . Read the full blog post here . October 31, 2024 by Deve ..:: Why average FPS and 1% low FPS are misleading ::.. SuperTuxKart 1.5 will feature a new integrated benchmark helping players to pick settings and to easily compare how different devices perform. This blog post dives on some of the details behind the design of this feature and showcase the benchmark mode in action. Check it out here . July 7, 2024 by Alayan ..:: On the way towards 1.5… and 2.0! ::.. 5 years after the release of SuperTuxKart 1.0, the release of STK 1.5 is drawing close. But the team has also started to work on the next major release that will feature new tracks and major gameplay changes. Read the full blog post here . April 27, 2024 by Alayan

Join the jumbo jamboree! The Mario Party series is back and more jam-packed than ever! With over 110 minigames, new online* and offline** modes, and plenty of customization choices, there’s something for every kind of partygoer! A selection of madcap minigames scrolls by. Mario and friends are ready to party! Check out this trailer to find out what's in store. Watch the trailer How to play In Mario Party mode, roll the dice to race others around the board in pursuit of Stars. Depending on where you land, all sorts of stuff can happen. Some outcomes can help, and some can hinder your chances of victory. Watch your step! From a flying saucer, Mario drops spikey blocks on Goomba, Daisy, and Peach in a 3 versus 1 minigame. Minigame mayhem After each player has a turn, everyone will clash in one of over 110 minigames! From running through merry-go-rounds to motion-control*** minigolf, this jamboree is jam-packed with excitement. Ninji gets a Star. Win with Stars The player with the most Stars at the end of the game wins. There are many ways you can get these celestial wonders, so try your best! Toadette lands on a Lucky Space that gives her 10 coins. Collect coins Grow your coin collection by winning minigames (or stealing ‘em from other players). Cash them in for Stars when you get a chance! A player uses a "Congrats!" reaction when Donkey Kong gets 10 coins. Later, Waluigi is offered by Boo to steal from another player, to which a player reacts "You wouldn't!" Say it with style Feeling happy? Utterly betrayed? Let ‘em know with in-game Reactions! A huge roster. A huuuge roster Play as one of 22 characters, including new additions Pauline and Ninji. It’s the most characters of any Mario Party game so far! The 22-character roster includes many Mario Party long-timers as well as newcomers Pauline and Ninji. Game changers Check out some of the new additions and choices available. Jamboree Buddies Win a Showdown Minigame to partner up with one of 10 Jamboree Buddies. These pals can help you out with all sorts of neat abilities. Also, just having one with you can allow you to do a bunch of things twice (like getting two Stars at once). They temporarily appear every now and then, so try to be the first to greet them! Party or Pro? Play with Party Rules when you want a more lighthearted Mario Party experience. Flip to Pro Rules when you want to downplay luck to focus on skill. Customize the fun Set some party parameters to make sure you and your guests can have the kind of fun you want. Configure the difficulty of CPU players, toggle Star handicaps, enable or disable Motion Minigames, and more. Boards a-plenty Have a blast on your choice of five new boards and two returning favorites. Roll ‘em Raceway A high-speed track where you can race and win! Mega Wiggler’s Tree Party The forest that Mega Wiggler calls home. Everyone’s making treats! Rainbow Galleria A three-story shopping mall crammed with stores to visit! Goomba Lagoon A large island with a Goomba-shaped volcano. Watch out for the tide! Western Land A nostalgic Old West town. Be careful around the tracks! Mario’s Rainbow Castle A castle above the clouds. Care to pay a visit to the Toad at its top? King Bowser’s Keep Impostor Bowser’s secret base! Watch out for attacks! Koopathlon Race across the party board in a series-first 20-player online competition to see who can rack up the highest scores in minigames. The higher your score in each round, the faster you’ll get to the goal! Up to 20 players online—1 per system. Single-player only offline. Players work together to smash crates, collect bombs, and items to defeat Impostor Bowser. Bowser Kaboom Squad Boom! Up to 8 players can work together online to defeat Impostor Bowser by scrambling to find bombs and blasting ‘em at the big lug. Do well in co-op minigames between rounds for a chance to receive helpful items! Up to 8 players online—1 per system. Single-player only offline. Four players swing spoons like baseball bats to smack fruit into a giant parfait. Rhythm Kitchen Up to 4 players can use Joy-Con™️️ controllers*** on the same system to slice, skewer, scoop, and more to the beat in motion-controlled, rhythm-based cooking minigames. Up to 4 players on the same system only. Equipped with wings that resemble a Koopa Paratroopas, Mario and Luigi fly while carrying a basket with Toad in it. Paratroopa Flight School Up to 2 players** can each use a pair of Joy-Con controllers to flap their arms and fly like a Koopa Paratroopa in three motion-based minigames. Up to 2 players on the same system only. A ball makes its way through a screen filled with fixed and movable platforms. Toad's Item Factory Ever wonder where Mario Party items like Dice Blocks come from? Right here! Up to 4 players on the same system can use Joy-Con motion controls to manipulate the machinery and guide materials safely where they need to go Up to 4 players on the same system only. Characters view a giant scroll with minigames listed on it. Minigame Bay Jump right into over 110 minigames—the most in any Mario Party game so far! external:kirby-air-riders.description: Kirby™ Air Riders for Nintendo Switch 2 - Nintendo Official Site Skip to main content Nintendo Nintendo Slide 1 of 11 Fantasy Violence Games Kirby™ Air Riders Version Nintendo Switch 2 Select an edition Digital - Kirby™ Air Riders Fantasy Violence Loading Fast-paced vehicular action Pick your rider, pick your machine, and mount up for competition! Take on your rivals in frantic arena battles or fast-paced races on the ground and in the air. Use the Boost Charge button to brake and control your turns as your machine automatically fights for top speed. Fill your Boost Charge Gauge as you drift around the bend and release it to trigger an explosive dash! RIDER BASICS Boost into the fray Ride and battle with just two buttons. Press the Boost Charge button to brake, drift, and fill your Boost Charge Gauge as your machine moves forward automatically. Once it’s full, dash forward with gusto! Battle with Quick Spin Wiggle the control stick to perform a spin attack. Slam into enemies to send them flying! Turn the tide with Specials Drive and fight to fill your Special Gauge. Once it’s full, you can activate your rider’s Special to edge out the competition. Grab Copy Abilities Inhale or capture an enemy to receive their Copy Ability. Some Copy Abilities let you attack, while others give you bonuses like a speed increase. RIDERS Slide 1 of undefined Kirby A light and floaty friend to all! This well-balanced hero has no clear weaknesses. King Dedede A heavyweight rider who rules the raceway! Hits hard with his powerful hammer. Meta Knight A shadowy defender who slashes rivals with his sword and slices through the air on dark wings. Bandana Waddle Dee A sturdy rider who builds Boost Charge quickly. His trusty spear stings rivals like a hornet! Knuckle Joe A fierce fighter who jabs at riders that come too close. Charge up fully for a flurry of punches! Cappy The mushroom cap doubles as a protective cushion. Race ahead of rivals before it falls apart! Star Man Excels at airborne maneuvers. Jump for a burst of speed and soar right over your rivals! Magolor A sly spell caster who accelerates a lot after Star Slides. Attack rivals ahead of you with perfect landings! Susie A smug, shiny entrepreneur. Deploys a propeller to take off and float gently through the air. MACHINES Slide 1 of undefined Warp Star Both drives and glides perfectly well. An easy ride with no clear weaknesses. Winged Star Slow when ground-bound, but soars gracefully whenever it takes flight. Wheelie Bike Races ahead on a single wheel. An interesting design compared to star-type machines. Paper Star Light as paper with impressive flight capabilities. Fragile, but offers excellent acceleration. Tank Star Rushes forward on Boost Dashes. Boost Charges help it tackle turns at a rapid pace. CITY TRIAL Explore Skyah Zip around the city of Skyah in City Trial: a free-for-all battle for 16 players online* or up to 8 players via local wireless.** You have 5 minutes to collect power-ups and prepare your machine for a Stadium contest. Power up your machine Find items scattered all over Skyah to raise your machine’s stats. Battle! Clash with rivals in a competition to claim power-ups! Watch out for opponents looking to thwart you by destroying your machine... Field Events Survive unpredictable Field Events like fearsome boss battles, falling meteors, and more! Stadium The final challenge takes place at the Stadium! The challenge is chosen from one of four randomly selected options. Try and pick one that suits your powered-up machine. AIR RIDE Race to the finish Drive, fight, and aim to cross the finish line first. Compete against a medley of riders in local and online matches with up to 5 other players. TOP RIDE Change your angle For a different perspective altogether, try Top Ride, where you view your Rider from a bird’s eye vantage and the entire track is on screen from start to finish. ROAD TRIP Discover the story of Zorah Complete stages of single-player challenges, featuring all the playstyles found in the game’s multiplayer modes, to progress through a wild and unusual story. Choose any rider you like, and put your skills to the test! ONLINE PLAY Slide 1 of undefined Meet up in the Paddock Gather groups of up to 32 players online* in the Paddock, a lobby where you can hang out to play matches in City Trial, Air Ride, Top Ride, and more. Compete for fun...or glory! Drift into a casual game online or dash and tussle for the top in all-out ranked matches. Deck out your ride Create a signature look for your machine using a spread of cosmetic options, including accessories, decals, patterns, special effects, and more. Trade at the Machine Market Buy and sell customized machines using Miles: in-game currency you can earn by competing and completing challenges. Software update required. The next evolution of Mario fun Classic Mario gameplay is turned on its head with Wonder Flowers in the Super Mario Bros. Wonder game! Play video Welcome to the Flower Kingdom Mario and friends have been invited to visit the colorful Flower Kingdom, just a short hop away from the Mushroom Kingdom. Unfortunately, King Bowser has transformed into a flying castle and is causing chaos across their peaceful land. Now our heroes must save the day—and the Flower Kingdom—in this wonderous new adventure! Play video Well, hi there! What a beautiful day. Life's full of surprises. Almost as weird as talking plants. Who will you pick? You can play as one of these heroic Super Mario characters! Mario Mario is always ready to help a friend, take on a new challenge, or jump on a Koopa’s head! Luigi Mario's “little” brother. When these bros team up, there's nothing they can't achieve! Peach The beloved princess of the Mushroom Kingdom, Peach is always ready to jump into action. Daisy She’s got a gown and a crown, but this friendly princess is totally down to earth. Toads Toads may be small, but they have big hearts! Toadette This pink-and-white member of the Toad species gets really pumped up when she’s out to save the day! Power up, team up, one up to save the Sprixie Kingdom! Pounce and climb through dozens of colorful courses! Jump, dash, and pounce to reach the goal while collecting Green Stars, coins and power-ups. Enemies, flowers, and even birds take on a feline form. Need some extra assistance bringing Bowser out of his frenzied, furious state? Push Me Pull You.title: Push Me Pull You by House House
Push Me Pull You.description: [please note: this game requires a controller to play] Push Me Pull You is an award-winning local multiplayer game about friendship and wrestling. Joined at the waist, you and your partner share a long, wriggling body as you wrestle your opponents for control of the ball. Since you're sharing the same body, you'll need to carefully communicate (or just shout a lot). With every action affecting both you and your partner, PMPY combines the best parts of co-op multiplayer with the worst parts of your last breakup. Frantic local multiplayer gameplay in the vein of Sportsfriends or Towerfall. Compete in multiple game types that will test your friendship in different ways, or play around in a sandbox area filled with toys and secrets. Low on controllers? Share a controller with a friend or try controlling two heads simultaneously - a two-player game can be played with just one controller! Accessible yet deep - play it as a noisy party game or hold a fiercely competitive grudge match.
